headline: AI coding startup Cognition in talks to raise funding at $75 billion valuation
summary: Cognition AI is negotiating a new capital funding round that would value the developer-focused startup at $75 billion, Bloomberg News reported.
why: Cognition AI develops autonomous AI coding software, and its rapidly accelerating valuation reflects intense venture capital interest in enterprise developer tools.

impacts.name: Cognition AI
